notes:
Ask for half the clip, or the middle of it.

"Keep the second half", "keep the last third", "cut the first half", "keep the middle 20 seconds" — all of these used to come back asking you for an amount, even though they name one exactly. Crisp works the range out from the length of your clip. It still asks when a request genuinely has no answer: "the middle" on its own names no boundary, and cutting a slice out of the middle would leave two pieces rather than one video.
